scope: Paired full-build and two-piece transition comparisons. All legacy actors use the complete immutable pre-change v2.8.4 catalog, including original Lumi20 deepening and both original four-piece effects. Current catalog uses declared candidate. Same bounded pressure and six-round diagnostic methodology as v286. Early cases are Lv1/C0/legal five-star+0 two-piece gear, zero blessings, six-round output only; floor1/10 reference enemy defense, not climbed routes.
